national_indicator_definition: The indicator measures the share of the population aged 25 to 64 in Bosnia and Herzegovina who participated in formal or non-formal education and training during the four weeks preceding the survey. It covers learning activities related to work as well as those unrelated to work. Higher indicator values indicate greater participation of adults in lifelong learning.
national_rationale: The data are collected through the Labour Force Survey conducted by the Agency for Statistics of Bosnia and Herzegovina (BHAS), in accordance with the methodological requirements of European labour force statistics. The indicator is calculated as the share of people aged 25 to 64 who participated in formal or non-formal education and training during the four weeks preceding the survey, out of the total number of people in the same age group who answered the question on participation in education and training. Data are collected and published annually. Progress is assessed based on changes in the indicator value over time. An increase in the share of adults participating in formal or non-formal education and training indicates positive progress in the development of lifelong learning. The progress shown reflects the trend in the indicator in relation to the long-term reference level of 28%, which represents the average of the best European results, and not a formally established national target for Bosnia and Herzegovina.
national_methodology_characteristics: The indicator covers the population aged 25 to 64 and refers to participation in formal and non-formal education and training during the four weeks preceding the survey. The use of a harmonised Labour Force Survey methodology enables comparisons between Bosnia and Herzegovina and EU Member States and other European countries. When analysing changes over time, methodological changes and the break in the time series in 2021, associated with the implementation of the new framework for European labour force statistics, should be taken into account.
national_long_objective: Increasing adult participation in education and training is an important prerequisite for developing human resources, improving employability, adapting to labour market needs and strengthening the competitiveness of the economy of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The long-term policy orientation is to gradually increase adult participation in lifelong learning by developing more accessible and flexible opportunities for formal and non-formal education and training, as well as improving the adult education system. No specific quantified national target has been established for this indicator.
eu_indicator_definition: The indicator measures the share of the population aged 25 to 64 who participated in formal or non-formal education and training during the four weeks preceding the survey. The denominator covers the total population in the same age group, excluding those who did not answer the question on participation in education and training. Adult learning includes learning activities related to work and those unrelated to work, and generally refers to learning activities undertaken after the completion of initial education.
eu_rationale: The data come from the European Union Labour Force Survey (EU-LFS), conducted within the framework of the European Statistical System (ESS). The indicator is calculated as the share of people aged 25 to 64 who reported participating in formal or non-formal education and training during the four weeks preceding the survey. Data are published annually.
eu_methodology_characteristics: The indicator covers people aged 25 to 64 who participated in formal or non-formal education and training, regardless of whether the activities were related to work. The data enable comparisons between EU Member States and other European countries. When analysing time series, methodological changes in the Labour Force Survey should be taken into account, including the break in the time series in 2021 due to the implementation of the new regulatory framework for European social statistics.
eu_long_objective: Adult participation in education and training is an important element of lifelong learning and the development of skills needed to adapt to changes in the labour market, technological developments, and the green and digital transitions. This area is one of the strategic priorities of the European Education Area. The long-term reference level for this indicator is 28% and represents the average of the best European results. This value should not be confused with the official EU target for 2030, which aims for at least 60% of adults aged 25 to 64 to participate in education or training during the previous 12 months. This target uses a different reference period from indicator 4.60.
